issue: हरो पाप हर शरण तुम्हारी — the book has हर; Drik Panchang and InstaAstro have हम ("we are in your refuge"). हर is a valid word (Hara, Śiva, whom the chālīsā names Gorakhnāth as: शिव गोरख, शंकर रूप), so the book's reading is kept, but the other is the easier sense.
our reading: Take away our sins, O Hara; [we are in] your refuge.
alternatives: हम शरण तुम्हारी: take away our sins, we are in your refuge.

issue: हरो रस भोगी — loose syntax: read as 'take away the (craving of the) enjoyer of pleasures', i.e. the devotee's relish for sense-pleasures.
our reading: grant siddhi, and take away the craving to enjoy pleasures.
alternatives: take away (the bonds of) us who enjoy pleasures; you who enjoy the rasa (of yoga), take away (our sorrow).
